name: GestaltEdit
description: GestaltEdit is a Swift editor for MobileGestalt on iOS 27 — the device configuration database that iOS uses to fingerprint hardware. Editing it is a jailbreak-adjacent technique used to spoof device features and unlock capabilities Apple gates per model. It went viral fast, hitting 261 stars in two days, a sign of how hungry the iOS modding scene is for proper tooling around MobileGestalt.
highlights: Editor for the MobileGestalt database on iOS 27
Swift tooling for a jailbreak-adjacent technique
261 stars in two days — fast viral pickup
Proper UI for a database usually poked at with hex tools
curatorNote: MobileGestalt editing has always been a hex-editor ritual. A dedicated Swift editor for iOS 27 makes the whole scene more approachable — hence the instant popularity.
